svg.aria-label: Fall Detection System drawn as one bench. A camera on a post watches a wooden mannequin lying on a mat. Cables run from the camera to a detector box whose window shows a bounding box (YOLOv8n), to a timer dial whose lit needle sits at 5 seconds (1 s confirms a fall, 5 s sends the alert, with a 60 s cooldown dial), and to a FastAPI backend. The backend files the alert in a SQLite drawer cabinet with a tray of snapshots, has a teleprinter with an antenna send the photo over Telegram, and pushes the alert to a dashboard terminal.

g.text: down 1 s = fall · 5 s = alert · 60 s cooldown

svg.text: A frame: 1 → 2 (detect) → 3 (time the fall); after 5 s down: 4 saves to 5, 6 sends the photo, 7 pops up the alert
